messages:
ajay_procure: FYI vendor updated ETAs — port congestion at SFO. RMA replacements delayed ~4-7 days. Some AWBs marked 'on hold'. :eyes:

lina_logistics: ugh. can we reroute to OAK or LAX and skirt the backlog? any customs paperwork change if we switch ports?

ethan_sre: short-term mitigation: shift affected traffic off west-1-prod to eu-dedicated for 48h. perf impact minimal for background jobs, but latency-sensitive routes will see +35ms.

maria_ops: cost callout? expedited air vs reroute vs refurbished swap? we need numbers to decide.

ajay_procure: vendor quoted options:
- standard reroute to OAK: $1,200 additional freight per consignment, ETA -2 days vs SFO.
- expedited air: ~$9k per 8x H100 consignment, ETA +0 days but customs risk remains.
- refurbished swap: vendor offers refurb pool, warranty transfer, ~2% perf delta, price credit $0 but faster availability (~48-72h)

procurement_bot: PO 4321 status updated: hold_flag=true, last_update=5189991200.

lina_logistics: if we take refurb swap we need burn-in logs, thermal cycle certs, and serial trace for compliance. vendor said they can provide burn-in within 24h.

ajay_procure: vendor provided serial ranges and AWB samples (they're holding until we confirm route):
```
AWB: FF1234567890 (on hold at SFO)
Serials: H100-SN-AAA1234 .. H100-SN-AAA1241
```

ethan_sre: request: approve refurb for non-prod only. For Dedicated customer nodes we must either get new units or take a prorated credit. No refurb on prod without SRE signoff.

maria_ops: affected clusters: west-1-prod (3 nodes), batch-inference-west (6 nodes, non-prod). If we patch with eu-dedicated for 48h + prune batch queue, expected customer impact <1%.

lina_logistics: got a cheaper forwarder quote to reroute to OAK: FastFreight $950/unit + handling; vendor willing to subsidize $400/unit if we accept a single consolidated AWB.

ajay_procure: quick math: reroute OAK net ~$550/unit extra; expedited air ~$9k/consignment; refurb swap likely $0 freight if vendor does crossdock, but we need acceptance of refurbished grade.

ethan_sre: proposal: 1) Accept refurb swap for batch-inference-west (non-prod) to recover capacity quickly. 2) Reroute prod-bound replacements to OAK using FastFreight, vendor subsidy applied. 3) Keep expedited air as last resort for any Dedicated SLA breach.

maria_ops: agreed. can procurement get vendor burn-in logs + serial manifest and confirm warranty transfer? also add a condition: refurb units must pass our 4-hour soak with perf within 5% of baseline.

ajay_procure: will get logs and manifest. will add soak condition to acceptance. emailing vendor now. cc'ing logistics. ETA on vendor ack ~2h.

lina_logistics: I'll lock forwarder quote for OAK and create reroute manifest if we get vendor ok.

ethan_sre: SRE will prep playbook for rolling the shifts and warm-up soak. node IDs to be swapped if ack: n-91, n-92, n-93 (west-1-prod).

maria_ops: noted. i'll notify account team, flag potential SLA exposure, and prep support runbook. :ship:

ajay_procure: vendor replied — burn-in logs incoming, they accept soak clause, will subsidize $400/unit if we consolidate AWB. vendor asked for final decision by EOD PST.

lina_logistics: locking FastFreight hold now. saving the AWB placeholder: FF/1234567890 (pending release).

maria_ops: schedule follow-up in 30m to confirm final decision and assign tasks. thanks all. :thumbsup:
